_comment: Source-of-truth for main branch protection (OSE-CI robustness). Apply/verify with scripts/apply-branch-protection.mjs. Required checks = the jobs that ALWAYS run to completion on a pull_request event (see .github/workflows/oursharedevents-ci.yml). Deliberately EXCLUDES: (a) the two known false-reds 'Claude PR Review' + 'Validate against OCR-docs brain' so they neither block nor need manual override; (b) the T1-T4 deploy/smoke/contract/functional jobs, which if:-skip on PRs and would deadlock every PR if required. strict=false because the single-runner pool cannot afford forced up-to-date re-runs of every open PR. See tools/ci/README-branch-protection.md.
